notes.title: Simulakros - Melee Combat is Available Now🗡️
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,

Following the news about [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2067160/view/502828986443763485"]the new melee weapon[/url], we’re excited to announce that the brand-new melee weapon is now available with today’s update!

You can jump in right away and try it out - [b]full patch notes are just below[/b]:

[/p][previewyoutube="oXstSmlwBv0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][table noborder="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534478/94ceaf23861dea07f12646703b1d5a0443765f50.png"][/img][/p][/th][th][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534478/38ed82139f333117a768481244e77efdfc47f21f.png"][/img][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534478/b4d68f960622bffc83885a6ec62f24e096776dc7.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534478/7b5d853530da5ec722a58d3c064561a102345769.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
[/p][h1]Patch Notes:[/h1][p]
[/p][h2]Sword[/h2][p]
[b]Melee combat has been overhauledn the kick has been replaced with a blade capable of:
[/b][/p][list][*][p] 3-Hit Combo: each attack deals progressively more damage.
   [/p][/*][*][p] Running Attack: a quick slash with a long forward movement, executed by pressing the melee button while sprinting or rolling.
   [/p][/*][*][p] Charged Attack: hold the melee button to charge a powerful swing capable of breaking an enemy's block.

[/p][/*][*][p] Enemies can now block melee attacks: the new Sword is very effective, but enemies have learned to block your attacks, so be careful! Enemies that are blocking can be hit by charged attacks or normal shots.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a sword tutorial to the Skill Info page.
[/p][/*][*][p] On gamepad, the default melee button has been remapped to A (instead of Right Stick) for more comfortable combo inputs.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p] New music has been added to exploration sections, and music behavior has been improved: more upbeat tracks activate during large encounters, with a new transition when combat ends.
[/p][/*][*][p] A new HUD panel has been added to the bottom-left corner that shows stats for the current level completion and the current Grade.
[/p][/*][*][p] The game's maximum volume output has been increased.
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved player colors: some unlockable colors have been retuned for better hue and contrast, and others have been updated to feature nicer color combinations.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Balancing[/h2][list][*][p] The “Counter” loadout power-up has been changed: it no longer staggers enemies on counter hit, but now deals more damage, promoting a more active playstyle that better suits the new melee system.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed an issue where when playing a character with a fully unlocked loadout, the quartz discs would not appear.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed collision on the ground near the entrance to the second boss arena.
[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2067160/Simulakros/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🧰 Sales Announcement & Patch 1.2 - Photo Mode 🧰
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534478/7addc2f258da9a51963cdbb15a36d530a9a3d5d8.jpg[/img]

Hello,

Great news everyone, Simulakros will be [b]25% off[/b] until the 20th of March! If you are a roguelike TPS fan, now's the time to try it out!

[b]Patch 1.2 [/b]introduces a brand new photo mode, so you can now capture all the details of your runs! It also brings a new difficulty selection menu, improved mechanics like grenade parrying and an overhauled "Counter" neural connection, as well as several quality of life changes based on community feedback

Thanks for all your feedback and bug reports over on [url=https://discord.gg/5WME5yJ9]Discord [/url]and Steam Community!


[h2]🔫 Patch notes 📄 [/h2]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[b][*] Photo mode[/b][/list] 

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a case when dying in cyberspace while targeting enemies with homing shots that would result in the targeting indicator frozen on screen.
[*] Fixed Barrage weapons briefly floating during some animations.
[*] Fixed "Tactical repositioning" neural connection cost being 0 on old saves.
[*] Fixed an issue that would make it very hard to deal weakspot hits on the final boss with Rupture's shotgun and grenade launcher.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] A new difficulty selection menu is replacing the hard mode toggle in character selection.
[*] Community feedback: toned down strength of cyberspace effect in biome 1 to improve visibility.
[*] Community feedback: added automatic "vacuuming" of all health and grenade pickups when encounters end (cyberspace, terminal rooms, bossfights).
[*] Added current difficulty displayed in the bottom left corner.
[*] Enemy grenades can be parried with melee attacks and launched back to damage enemies.
[*] Sharpshooter rifle screenshake intensity gets reduced when firerate increases a lot to not feel disorienting.
[*] "Counter" neural connection has been overhauled: melee hits against enemies that are about to attack stun (10s cooldown) now deal massive damage and stagger. The counter window has been adjusted for all enemy attacks to make it more forgiving. Equip cost went down  from 4  to 3.
[*] The navigation line can now be used after completing a terminals room to find the exit.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced enemy amount in first biome.
[*] Reduced enemy HP in fist biome.
[*] Improved parameters for generating levels to be more consistent and avoid generating levels that are too long.
[*] Increased XP bonus from arena grades and reduced XP from enemies so that it's more important to get good grades to get to a high level.
[*] Community feedback: cyberspace kill combo: reduced random amount of kill combo to reach from 8-14 to 7-12.
[*] Cyberspace defeat all enemies: increased intensity by increasing enemy count but reducing the amount of enemy waves to make the encounter shorter.
[*] Community feedback: skill usage grade takes into account more how effective the skill use was (eg: amount of damage dealt during timeshift, number of enemies hit by magnetic pull, etc.) instead of the frequency of using skills to make it easier to get S grades during speedruns.
[*] Removed grenade amount limit, reduced grenade drop rate.
[*] Increased size of weakspot hitbox of the first boss.
[*] Improved second boss movement logic and increased movement speed of barrage boss.
[/list]

Stay connected for more Simulanews and thanks for the support!

[h3][i]⭐ If you like the game, feel free to share your review with us! ⭐ [/i][/h3]

notes.title: 🧰 Patch 1.1 - In-Run Save System & Game Balance 🧰
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534478/7addc2f258da9a51963cdbb15a36d530a9a3d5d8.jpg[/img]

Hello,

In [b]Patch 1.1[/b] we’ve made several key improvements to enhance the game: we are introducing a new[b] in-run save system[/b], which offers more flexibility allowing you to suspend runs and continue them later, significant game [b]balance adjustments[/b] to make the game more fun and we've also addressed a variety of bugs and issues.

Thank you for your feedback and bug reports on [url=https://discord.gg/mZhb4Gu4] Discord [/url] and Steam community!

[h2]🔫 Patch notes 📄 [/h2]

[b]New Features[/b]

[b]In-run Save System:[/b] progress is saved after terminal rooms and upon reaching a new Biome, allowing players to quit the game and continue their run later. Run savedata is cloud-synced so runs can be continued on a different device too.

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed loading screen not showing when going back to main menu
[*] Fixed turrets sometimes not attacking in the second biome
[*] Fixed some lasers not dealing damage
[*] Fixed an issue where Barrage would lose too much fire rate after a fire rate buff expires
[*] Fixed Barrage pistol charge sound persisting when returning to main menu
[*] Fixed looping turret sound that kept playing after dying
[*] Fixed some issues with the navigation line in the third biome
[*] Fixed run timer not paused correctly between some level connections
[*] Fixed material glitch on the walls in the third biome
[*] Fixed combat music staying active after the second boss
[*] Fixed some incorrect voiceline triggered on run start after the final boss has beed defeated at least once
[*] Fixed a misplaced cyberspace terminal inside a wall
[*] Fixed slow motion effect sound staying when dying during Timeshift
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Runs are now considered as completed for stats upon killing the final boss, even after unlocking access to the true ending section
[*] Invincibility frames on the dodgeroll are now shown with an effect on the character
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Bosses have been rebalanced[/b] to focus more on the fight with the boss itself, bosses are now more dangerous, their attacks are more frequent and complex to avoid while additional enemies spawning have been significantly reduced, only some weak enemies keep spawning as a way to get some health drops and trigger kill-related powerups.
[*] The option to Increase health on level up has been removed, instead every level up grants +100 max health, ensuring a smoother power increase.
[*] Player characters now have a base crit chance of 5% up from 0%
[*] Enemy health has been reduced for most enemies
[*] Health drops have been rebalanced, they drop more frequently and recharge a bit more health, taking damage is a bit less punishing and it's easier to recover when playing well
[*] Some powerul enemies in later stages deal a bit more damage to adjust for the increased health amounts and more accessible healing from health drops
[*] Difficulty curve has been adjusted to be more forgiving for the first half of the game and gradually get harder
[*] Hard mode has been tweaked to be slightly more challenging
[*] Drone projectiles have been tweaked to be easier to avoid
[*] Turret damage has been reduced
[/list]

Stay connected for more Simulanews and thanks for the support!

[h2]🤖 Play NOW 🔫 [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2067160/Simulakros/

[h3][i]⭐ If you like the game, feel free to share your review with us! ⭐ [/i][/h3]

notes.title: Dev Diary 📕
notes.content:
[b]The project started in 2019[/b] as a passion project developed for fun by [b]Sigfrido Cosmo[/b] (game designer) in his free time, as a fan of roguelikes and third person shooters he wanted to experiment creating this unique mix of genres that is quite rare. 

As the game started to take shape, two friends joined the development: [b]Filippo Colombo[/b] (level designer) and [b]Lorenzo Erialti[/b] (sound designer and composer).
	
From the beginning we knew we wanted the game to be about advanced AI technology and taking control of synthetic bodies, we felt it was a good match with the gameplay loop of roguelikes that is about dying over and over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534478/3af1215d2b776d29b23138519330da9da4d6928f.gif[/img]

The name “[b]Simulakros[/b]” is a mix of the latin word “[b]simulacrum[/b]” meaning representation of something, and the greek word “[b]mechanikos[/b]” meaning mechanical, with an additional play on word with the ending SimulakrOS which stands for Operating System.

In [b]2022 [/b]the game started to become a reality after signing with the publisher [b]Plug in Digital[/b]. We started working with a few freelancers for concept art, character art and rigging. Another friend joined, [b]Alex Gallucci[/b] (3D artist).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534478/c12ad1df02aec4250cb3557cbc543b5bb2ee238e.png[/img]

In [b]2024 [/b]as the game was reaching the peak production we found another core member of the team [b]Matteo Scarcella[/b] (3D artist) and started cooperating with [b]Shoganai Soft[/b] to help us with environment art, especially with Imanol [b]Delgado Salazar[/b] (Lead Artist), an old time friend of Sigfrido and Filippo from the time they all worked at CD Projekt RED.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534478/f47c65c6cd954046cfefe04b7bf3d9395e02c1fd.png[/img]

[b]Sigfrido Cosmo[/b] (Game Designer) has been working on Simulakros as [b]his passion project for over four years[/b]. He set out to create a game that he would truly enjoy, focusing on both excellent gameplay and great visuals, all while aiming for the highest level of quality possible. As a [b]solo developer [/b]with limited resources, balancing the roles of designer and programmer has been challenging, especially while managing every aspect of the project in his free time. However, it feels incredible for him to finally release the game. [b]He is immensely proud of the result and he is super happy to see players enjoying his game. [/b]

notes.title: Simulakros Demo - Patch Notes
notes.content:
We updated the Demo for Simulakros with a bunch of fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed some holes in some maps
[*] Fixed a problem where switching Lumen Global Illumination to off during a run would cause the enviroment to appear too dark
[*] Fixed Homing Shots skill not targeting enemies after spawning when targeting was active before the spawn
[*] Improved environment and lighting in big terminal rooms
[*] Fixed some rooms spawning too many enemies
[*] Fixed door sometimes not opening after completing a terminal room, preventing progress 
[*] Improved enemy movement in the environments
[*] Added randomization rule that prevents spawning the same terminal room two times in a row across different runs
[/list]

notes.title: Rogue AIs, Rebel Hackers Unite. 3 Units, 1 Mission to annihilate evil CORP!
notes.content:
[h3]PID Games publishing label and Sirio Games, an indie game development studio, have come together to defy the evil CORP by using their own creation "Simulakros"" unit against them. Excitement loaded as Steam Demo goes live on Oct 9th to bring back the fast-paced, third person shooter spirit through the game Simulakros with rogue-lite elements.[/h3]

[h2]DEMO AVAILABLE: October 9th 2023![/h2]

[h3]So, we are delighted to announce that Simulakros will be releasing next year on PC. Meanwhile to make it worth your wait, we will be releasing a Steam Demo for Simulakros during our participation in the Steam Next Fest from 9th- 16th October 2023. 

Fight the evil CORP from the inside. Confront deadly robots in this fast-paced third person shooter with rogue-lite elements.[/h3]

[h3][b]THIRD PERSON FAST PACED SHOOTER [/b]

Defy the CORP by using their own creation against them, the Simulakros Unit, equipped with advanced weapons and abilities to wreak havoc to their facilities. 

[b]RANDOMIZED LEVELS WITH HANDCRAFTED LEVEL DESIGN [/b]

Enjoy randomly generated levels composed of carefully crafted parts. Each run the game will be different as the environment keeps changing while staying true to the designer’s vision. 

[b]3 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS [/b]

Take control of 3 different Simulakros Units, each having their own unique playstyle with unique weapons, skills and power-ups. 

[b]Sharpshooter[/b]: Sharp and deadly. Fight from a distance with this unit equipped with high precision rifles capable of charging devastating shots and time-manipulation abilities. 

[b]Barrage[/b]: Fast and ruthless. Wield a short-range SMG and a long-range pistol with this unit equipped with explosive energy-based abilities. 

[b]Rupture[/b]: Powerful and fearless. Bring the fight to them with a close-range shotgun and powerful grenades. This unit is pure aggression, capable of surprising enemies by teleporting behind them. [/h3]

notes.title: Simulakros Online: Initiating Core Systems...in...3...2...1
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, fellow gamers and seekers of virtual adventures![/h2]

[h3]We're thrilled to introduce you to a brand-new dimension of excitement with the launch of the Steam Store Page for Simulakros! We revealed the game at Gamescom 2023.

So many players got a sneak[strike]peak[/strike] sneak-feel of the game through the demo and got the chance to play it first-hand and exclusively chat with the dev! We gathered so much feedback since the game is still under progress. We are aware that some people will be waiting for more news about the game progress but before you dive in headfirst, let's take a quick look behind the scenes, shall we? [/h3]

[h2][b]Meet the Makers: Sirio Games Unveiled[/b] 🕹️ [/h2]

[h3]Imagine a group of friends who decided to turn their passion for gaming into a reality – that's how Sirio Games came to life! A bunch of creative minds collided, and the result? A playground where their imaginations ran wild, giving birth to the captivating world of Simulakros. With Sirio Games, gameplay is the foundation above which we build everything else, to create an experience that is fun and engaging, with the right amount of mystery and atmosphere. [/h3]

[h2]🤖 [b]The Heart of the Matter: What's Simulakros All About?[/b] 🤖 [/h2]

[h3]Gear up for a rollercoaster ride, because in Simulakros, you'll be facing off against relentless robots in a fast-paced third-person shooter that's got a sprinkling of rogue-lite magic! Get ready for a fresh adventure every time you dive in, as the environment switches things up. And that's not the end of it – brace yourself for a trio of characters, each with their distinct playstyle. It's all about that gaming variety in Simulakros! [/h3]

[h2]📜 [b]The Story Behind the Mayhem[/b] 📜 [/h2]

[h3]The CORP – those typical bad guys with big plans – are cooking up the ultimate weapon, the Simulakros unit. But guess what? You're not about to let them have all the fun. Armed with your wit and a mysterious hacker by your side, you're here to flip the script! [/h3]

[h2]Your support means the cosmos to us, so don't miss the chance to add Simulakros to your wishlist and gear up to face deadly robots! [/h2]
